desc: The Frigidaire 30" Gas Range with Quick Boil allows you to experience faster boil times with the 18,000 BTU Quick Boil burner and our flexible five burner cooktop was designed to fit all your cooking needs. For easier cleanup, our Steam Clean cycle provides a quick 30-minute oven cleaning that's chemical-free, odor-free and fast.
hl: Experience faster boil times and more powerful cooking with the 18,000 BTU burner.
Designed to meet all of your cooking needs with a 5,000-BTU simmer burner, 10,000-BTU center oval burner, and 18,000-BTU Quick Boil Burner.
Designed to deliver even baking results, every time.
A light, 30-minute oven cleaning that's chemical-free, odor-free and fast.
Moving heavy pots and pans across the cooktop is easier with continuous edge-to-edge grates.
Redesigned to be even wider - allowing you to store any unused oven racks, baking trays and more!
